archetypes.name: contract-cartographer
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a new canonical reference plus load directives, sentinel schema, helper contracts, and structure guards that can drift independently.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every proposed Step 9a.1 contract from the written plan to the scoped files and existing repo evidence: mandatory load points, helper see-also pointers, sentinel writer/reader expectations, duplicate URL handling, and post-checkpoint ownership. Look for places where the plan names a contract but does not specify the exact file anchor, wording, invocation fragment, or guard needed to keep consumers aligned. Pay special attention to whether the new reference file would become canonical without creating a second competing source of truth in SKILL.md. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
